hero.title: Oceania World Cruises and Grand Voyages: What to Know Before Booking
hero.subtitle: Explore 180-Day Around the World Journeys for 2028 & 2029, Extended Grand Voyages, Inclusions, Costs and Planning Tips Aboard Oceania Aurelia
hero.description: An Oceania World Cruise or Grand Voyage offers an unparalleled way to explore the globe: spend weeks or months discovering dozens of countries across multiple continents aboard the same intimate luxury ship with world-class dining, refined small-ship luxury, and generous inclusive packages.

editorialIntro.heading: Circumnavigate the Globe in Refined Small-Ship Elegance
paragraphs: An Oceania World Cruise or Grand Voyage offers a different way to travel: instead of visiting one destination and returning home, you spend weeks or months exploring multiple countries aboard the same ship.

Oceania Cruises has expanded its longer-voyage program with 180-day Around the World journeys for 2028 and 2029, along with Grand Voyages that explore regions such as Northern Europe, the Baltics, South America and the Mediterranean.

The distinction matters when choosing a trip. A World Cruise is designed for travelers who want an extensive global journey, while a Grand Voyage generally focuses on a particular region or connects several destinations over a shorter period.

Oceania's announced 2028 and 2029 World Cruises will sail aboard Oceania Aurelia, a ship planned to debut in late 2027. The 2028 voyage departs Miami on January 18 and arrives in New York after 180 days. The 2029 voyage departs Los Angeles on January 6 and also concludes in New York after 180 days. The line has also announced two 2028 Grand Voyages: a 78-day Nordic and Baltic journey from New York to Boston and a 71-day South America journey from Miami to Los Angeles. This guide explains the differences between these extended journeys, itineraries, ships, booking options, inclusions, costs and practical planning details.

worldCruise2028Highlights.title: Oceania's 2028 World Cruise: Around the World in 180 Days
worldCruise2028Highlights.subtitle: Sailing aboard Oceania Aurelia, departing Miami on January 18, 2028, and arriving in New York after visiting 6 continents, 35 countries, 88 ports and 10 overnight stays.

items.title: Mexico and Central America
items.description: The voyage begins in Miami and proceeds toward the Pacific through the Panama Canal region, introducing travelers to vibrant Mexican and Central American coastal cultures before venturing across the Pacific.
bulletPoints: Daylight transit of the historic Panama Canal engineering wonder
Exploration of Mexican coastal towns and Central American rainforest ports
Rich colonial history and tropical wildlife before open-ocean cruising

items.title: Hawaii and the South Pacific
items.description: The Pacific crossing includes Hawaiian island ports alongside French Polynesia and the wider South Pacific, featuring legendary lagoons, volcanic peaks, and Polynesian traditions.
bulletPoints: Calls in Oahu, Maui, and the Big Island of Hawaii
Bora Bora, Tahiti, and Moorea with crystal turquoise lagoons
Authentic island welcomes, traditional music, and coral reef exploration

items.title: Australia and New Zealand
items.description: Cross the International Date Line to discover the dramatic contrast between iconic cosmopolitan hubs like Sydney and Auckland and the raw natural beauty of New Zealand's fjords and Australia's coast.
bulletPoints: Sydney Harbour scenic arrival and overnight city exploration
New Zealand's geothermal wonders in Rotorua and Milford Sound scenic cruising
Great Barrier Reef gateway ports and unique Australian wildlife encounters

items.title: Southeast Asia and East Asia
items.description: Immerse in Asia's dynamic blend of ancient heritage and futuristic architecture, savoring regional street food traditions, Buddhist temples, and bustling cosmopolitan centers.
bulletPoints: Singapore, Bangkok (Laem Chabang), and Ho Chi Minh City
Calls across Japan, Taiwan, and coastal East Asian hubs
Chef-led market excursions and UNESCO World Heritage temple visits

items.title: India, Maldives & Arabian Peninsula
items.description: Navigate the Indian Ocean, calling at tropical atolls in the Maldives, historic trading ports in India, and the glittering architectural marvels of the Arabian Peninsula.
bulletPoints: Overnight in Dubai with futuristic skylines and desert safari options
Idyllic coral reefs and turquoise waters of Malé in the Maldives
Cultural immersion in Cochin and Mumbai with spice market tours

items.title: The Mediterranean and Europe
items.description: The final European chapter visits classic Mediterranean ports in Greece, Croatia, Italy, Spain, and France, continuing through the British Isles before the transatlantic crossing to New York.
bulletPoints: Venice, Rome (Civitavecchia), Barcelona, and French Riviera ports
Overnights in key cultural capitals allowing evening dining ashore
Transatlantic crossing arriving triumphantly in New York Harbor

shipAureliaOverview.title: Oceania Aurelia: Designed for Global Exploration

features: Fewer than 250 staterooms ensuring tranquil public lounges
Direct docking at historic city wharves without lengthy bus transfers
Uncrowded pool decks, quiet observation libraries, and sun lounges
Personalized service with an exceptional staff-to-guest ratio

items.title: Extensive Dining Variety with Zero Surcharges

items.description: On a voyage lasting six months, menu variety is critical. Aurelia features multiple open-seating specialty restaurants, destination-inspired dishes that evolve with every port, and hands-on cooking classes in The Culinary Center.
features: Multiple open-seating specialty dining venues included in the fare
Rotating destination menus incorporating fresh local ingredients
Hands-on Culinary Center with individual chef cooking stations
Casual Terrace Café and poolside Waves Grill for relaxed dining

items.title: Generous Storage & Residential Comfort
items.lead: Your Private Oceanfront Home Away from Home
items.description: Staterooms and suites on Aurelia are engineered specifically for multi-month travel, featuring walk-in closets, abundant drawer storage, Tranquility Beds with Egyptian cotton linens, marble bathrooms with rainfall showers, and private teak verandas.
features: Expanded wardrobe and luggage storage designed for 180 days
Private teak balconies for scenic ocean and harbor viewing
Dedicated European-trained butler service in all suite tiers
Complimentary in-suite bar setup with premium spirits and wine

preparationPillars.title: Preparing for a Long Oceania Cruise
preparationPillars.description: A voyage lasting several weeks or months requires thoughtful advance organization across travel, health, home, and personal affairs.

items.title: Passports, Visas & Entry Regulations
items.description: Ensure your passport has at least six months' validity beyond the cruise conclusion and ample blank visa pages. Review visa requirements for all 30+ destinations well in advance, even if utilizing an included visa support package.

items.title: Medical Planning & Prescriptions
items.description: Consult your physician 6 months before sailing to arrange a full 180-day supply of maintenance medications. Secure copies of medical records, verify travel medical insurance with emergency evacuation, and obtain destination vaccines.

items.title: Home, Property & Financial Management
items.description: Arrange automated bill payments, home maintenance, mail forwarding, and security checks. Notify your bank and credit card issuers of your multi-country itinerary to ensure uninterrupted global card access.

items.title: Multi-Climate Wardrobe Planning
items.description: A World Cruise crosses diverse climates from tropical South Pacific warmth to brisk North Atlantic sea breezes. Take advantage of included laundry services and pack versatile layers that mix and match easily.

wardrobePacking.title: What to Pack for a Multi-Month Cruise
wardrobePacking.subtitle: Planning attire for six months across multiple hemispheres and climate zones.

categories.title: Multi-Climate Clothing Essentials
categories.description: Pack versatile, breathable garments that can be layered for tropical heat and chilly ocean breezes.
items: Lightweight linen and cotton daytime resort wear for tropical ports
Breathable moisture-wicking shirts and comfortable walking shorts/pants
Warm mid-layers, cashmere sweaters, and a fleece jacket for cooler latitudes
High-performance waterproof, windproof jacket with a protective hood
Elegant casual evening attire: collared shirts, trousers, sundresses, and blazers
Modest clothing covering shoulders and knees for temple and cathedral visits

categories.title: Footwear & Essential Accessories
categories.description: Supportive walking shoes and accessories ensure comfort during long shore excursions.
items: Two pairs of thoroughly broken-in walking shoes with non-slip traction
Sturdy water-resistant walking shoes or lightweight hiking boots
Smart casual leather loafers, boat shoes, or evening flats for dinner
Polarized UV-blocking sunglasses, wide-brim sun hat, and compact umbrella
Compact high-definition binoculars for wildlife viewing and scenic cruising
Universal travel adapters, multi-plug surge-free extension, and e-readers

categories.title: Laundry & Luggage Strategy
categories.description: Leverage Oceania's inclusive laundry perks to travel with manageable luggage.
items: Take advantage of Oceania's unlimited laundry services included in World Cruise packages
Self-service complimentary launderettes available on stateroom decks with free detergent
Pack for approximately 14 days of rotation rather than 180 individual outfits
Utilize Oceania's included door-to-door luggage delivery services for hassle-free transit
Keep essential medications, fine jewelry, and travel documents in your personal carry-on

features: 24-hour dedicated butler service throughout all 180 days
Spacious walk-in closet with ample drawer and hanging storage
In-suite dining served course-by-course from specialty restaurants
Priority shore excursion reservations and tender embarkation

items.name: Oceania & Owner's Suites

items.description: The pinnacle of luxury world cruising. These expansive residential sanctuaries feature separate master bedrooms, guest powder rooms, private whirlpool tubs, wrap-around teak verandas overlooking the ship's bow or wake, and customized in-suite bar setups.

Expansive wraparound teak verandas with private outdoor whirlpools
Complimentary customized full-bar setup with premium spirits and champagne
Exclusive private shoreside car transfers and VIP event access

dailyLife.title: Daily Life Aboard an Oceania World Cruise
dailyLife.subtitle: Life at sea on an extended voyage establishes a relaxing, enriching, and deeply satisfying rhythm.

items.title: Culinary Variety & Epicurean Discovery
items.description: With multiple open-seating specialty restaurants, daily rotating menus inspired by the destinations visited, and hands-on cooking classes at The Culinary Center, every meal is an adventure without ever repeating unless you wish.

items.title: Enrichment Lectures & Guest Speakers
items.description: World-renowned historians, former diplomats, naturalists, and culinary masters deliver captivating presentations on upcoming ports, geopolitical context, regional art, and maritime history during relaxing sea days.

items.title: An Intimate, Enduring Global Community
items.description: Spending six months with like-minded travelers creates lasting friendships. Guests bond over afternoon trivia, wine tastings, bridge tournaments, and shared dinners while sharing stories of global exploration.

items.title: Wellness, Fitness & Rejuvenation
items.description: Maintain your health and vitality at the Aquamar Spa + Vitality Center. Enjoy ocean-view yoga, personal training, fitness classes, restorative thermal suite relaxation, and therapeutic body treatments.

items.title: Unrushed Sea Days & Quiet Sanctuaries
items.description: Unlike frantic port-intensive weeklong cruises, a World Cruise features balanced sea days. Spend unhurried afternoons reading in the English-style library, relaxing on the sun deck, or watching waves from the observation lounge.

whatIsIncluded.title: What Is Included on an Oceania World Cruise?
whatIsIncluded.subtitle: Oceania provides the generous Your World Included package plus the Exclusive Prestige Package on full World Cruises.
whatIsIncluded.includedTitle: Included with Full World Cruise Bookings
whatIsIncluded.extrasTitle: Optional Services That May Cost Extra

included.title: First Class Air & Airport Transfers
included.description: Included First Class roundtrip airfare from select North American gateways plus coordinated private transfers between airport, hotel, and ship.

included.title: Pre-Cruise Luxury Hotel Stay & Luggage Delivery
included.description: One-night pre-cruise luxury hotel stay in the embarkation city plus door-to-door luggage delivery service from your home to your stateroom.

included.title: All Specialty Dining with Zero Surcharges
included.description: Open-seating dining in all specialty restaurants, including steakhouse, Italian, Asian, and French venues, with zero cover charges throughout the 180 days.

included.title: Shipboard Gratuities & Unlimited Laundry
included.description: Prepaid standard shipboard gratuities for stateroom attendants, waitstaff, and butlers, plus unlimited complimentary laundry services.

included.title: Wine/Beer Package OR up to $9,000 Excursion Credit
included.description: Choice between unlimited wine and beer during lunch and dinner or a generous shore excursion credit of up to $9,000 per stateroom.

included.title: Onboard Medical Consultations & Visa Package
included.description: Onboard medical consultations with the ship's physician included under package terms, plus comprehensive visa handling support for included destinations.

extras.title: Premium Spirits Outside Package Terms
extras.description: Ultra-premium spirits, rare vintage wines, and cocktails outside included beverage package terms require individual purchase.

extras.title: Excursions Beyond Amenity Credit
extras.description: Shore excursions exceeding your booking's $9,000 credit or specialized private overland overland excursions require separate payment.

extras.title: Aquamar Spa & Salon Treatments
extras.description: A la carte body massages, acupuncture, facial treatments, and salon styling services carry standard spa fees.

extras.title: Comprehensive Travel & Medical Evacuation Insurance
extras.description: Trip cancellation, emergency interruption, and medical evacuation insurance are strongly advised and purchased separately.

extras.title: Personal Shopping & Retail Boutiques
extras.description: Boutique shopping, fine jewelry, artisan souvenirs, and personal incidental expenses incurred ashore or onboard.

valueComparison.includedTitle: Advantages of a Single World Cruise

included.title: Zero Repeated Long-Haul Flights
included.description: Eliminates dozens of round-trip international flights, jet lag cycles, airport security queues, and baggage transfers across a multi-year period.

included.title: Unpack Once for Six Months
included.description: Your suite is your continuous sanctuary. Avoid packing and unpacking across dozens of hotel rooms, train stations, and regional cruise lines.

included.title: Bundled Luxury Prestige Amenities
included.description: Full world cruise bookings bundle First Class Air, pre-cruise hotels, luggage delivery, shoreside galas, and up to $9,000 in excursion credits.

questions.answer: Yes. Oceania has announced 180-day Around the World voyages for 2028 and 2029 aboard Oceania Aurelia.

questions.question: How long is an Oceania World Cruise?
questions.answer: The announced 2028 and 2029 Around the World voyages are each 180 days long, or approximately six months.

questions.question: Which ship will operate Oceania's 2028 World Cruise?
questions.answer: Oceania Aurelia is scheduled to operate the 2028 Around the World voyage. The ship is planned to debut in late 2027.

questions.question: When does the 2028 Oceania World Cruise depart?
questions.answer: The announced 2028 voyage is scheduled to depart Miami on January 18, 2028, and arrive in New York after 180 days.

questions.question: When does the 2029 Oceania World Cruise depart?
questions.answer: The announced 2029 voyage is scheduled to depart Los Angeles on January 6, 2029, and arrive in New York after 180 days.

questions.question: What countries are included in the 2028 Oceania World Cruise?
questions.answer: The published route includes destinations across 35 countries and six continents. Regional highlights include the Americas, Hawaii, French Polynesia, Australia, Asia, India, the Arabian Peninsula and Europe.

questions.question: How many ports are included in the 2028 World Cruise?
questions.answer: Oceania's published 2028 itinerary lists 88 ports and 10 overnight stays.

questions.question: What is the difference between an Oceania World Cruise and a Grand Voyage?
questions.answer: A World Cruise is a long global journey that can connect several continents over approximately six months. A Grand Voyage is generally shorter and focuses on one region or a combination of connected regions.

questions.question: How long are Oceania Grand Voyages?
questions.answer: The duration varies. The announced 2028 Grand Nordic & Baltic Discovery is 78 days, while the Grand South America Adventure is 71 days. Other extended voyages can be shorter or longer.

questions.question: What is the 2028 Grand Nordic & Baltic Discovery?
questions.answer: It is a 78-day voyage aboard Oceania Aurelia, scheduled to depart New York on July 18, 2028, and arrive in Boston. The route includes Greenland, Iceland, the Faroe Islands, the British Isles, Norway, Scandinavia, the Baltics and Western Europe.

questions.question: What is the 2028 Grand South America Adventure?
questions.answer: It is a 71-day voyage aboard Oceania Aurelia, scheduled to depart Miami on October 27, 2028, and arrive in Los Angeles. The route includes Caribbean destinations and a journey around South America.

questions.question: Can I book only part of an Oceania World Cruise?
questions.answer: Some extended voyages may offer shorter segments, subject to availability and the applicable booking terms. Not every port is necessarily an approved embarkation or disembarkation point.

questions.question: Are World Cruise segments more affordable than booking the entire voyage?
questions.answer: A segment may have a lower total fare because it covers fewer days, but the per-day value and included amenities can differ. Compare the actual segment fare and benefits with the full-voyage offer.

questions.question: Does the 2028 Oceania World Cruise include airfare?
questions.answer: Oceania's published 2028 Exclusive Prestige Package lists First Class Air as a benefit. Eligibility, routing, conditions and other terms should be confirmed for the specific booking.

questions.question: Does Oceania include laundry on its World Cruise?
questions.answer: The published 2028 World Cruise Prestige Package lists unlimited laundry services. Standard Your World Included laundry-related benefits and other voyage offers may have different conditions. Confirm the package attached to your reservation.
